_meta.note: Completes the NYT Connections Extended board. S265 ingested only the top-20 slice a WebFetch summary returned; re-verification against the raw README showed the board has 339 rows. Effort-suffixed ids are used where they exist in the DB; otherwise the model's best effort tier is written to the base id (best-per-base, matching prior sessions). Rows that already existed are untouched. IMPORTANT: the README also carries partial-coverage boards (100 puzzles, 194/940, 651/940, 759/940 ...) whose rows look identical apart from a 5th coverage column; an initial pass mixed them in and produced 49 wrong rows (e.g. GLM-5.2 89.5 from the 194-puzzle board). Only exactly-4-field rows reporting 940 puzzles are accepted here.
